info.title: qts research workbench API
info.description:
Run registry, trial ledger, config schema and background pipeline jobs of the `qts`
research workbench. Errors are RFC 7807 problem details (`application/problem+json`)
with a string `detail`. Non-finite floats (NaN / inf) are serialised as `null`.

Get Config Schema
Effective warm-up for the default config
get.description:
Derived from ``risk.min_history_days``, ``alpha.train_min_days`` (with ML),
``alpha.horizon_days`` and the signal lag of the default ``SystemConfig``.  A
launch with ``config_overrides`` is checked against its own config.

post.summary: Dry run of a launch: errors, warnings, the resulting config hash and warm-up
post.description:
Takes the body of ``POST /api/runs`` and prepares it the same way (base config of
``base_run_id`` or the defaults, overrides through ``SystemConfig.with_overrides``,
seed, signal lag), without queueing anything.  Config problems come back as
``errors`` with a 200 (``valid: false``); only a malformed body is a 422.

The holdout seal, every unseal, runs under it

What k new trials do to a family's deflated Sharpe ratio (trial_impact)
get.description:
The family's trial count before / after, ``N_eff``, ``E[max SR]`` and the current
best trial's DSR before and after ``n_new`` independent new trials
(:func:`qts.research.sweep.trial_impact`, the numbers ``qts sweep`` prints).

Once per configuration: a second run is refused (409) unless ``force`` with
``confirm`` equal to the status's ``force_phrase``; the repeat is flagged on its
ledger record.  A dry run (coverage and plan only) is always allowed.

sign.title: Sign
sign.description: +1 / -1 as the composite uses the feature; +1 for ML-only features

mean_ic.title: Mean Ic
mean_ic.description: full-sample mean daily rank IC of sign x feature against the training label

t_stat.title: T Stat
t_stat.description: Newey-West t with the label overlap as the bandwidth floor

source.title: Source
source.description: daily_sleeves: daily rank IC per sleeve with Newey-West t; sampled_combined: the sampled ic.parquet (combined only, plain t) for runs written before the sleeve IC was recorded

overlap_days.title: Overlap Days
overlap_days.description: label overlap (horizon + signal lag) the t-statistics allow for

refit_date.title: Refit Date
refit_date.description: first date the refit's model predicts for

train_end.title: Train End
train_end.description: last label date used; the embargo separates it from refit_date

blend_weights.title: Blend Weights
blend_weights.description: ensemble member weights by sleeve (sum 1); empty for a bare model

AlphaRefitWindow.title: AlphaRefitWindow
AlphaRefitWindow.description: One walk-forward refit of the ML sleeve (``alpha_refits.json``).

sleeves.title: Sleeves
sleeves.description: lgbm / ridge / mlp / ensemble, those recorded

importance.title: Importance
importance.description: sleeve -> feature -> one raw value per refit (aligned with `refits`); null where not recorded

recorded.title: Recorded
recorded.description: false for runs written before the refits were recorded

AlphaRefits.title: AlphaRefits
AlphaRefits.description:
Learned weights over time: raw per-sleeve feature importance per refit (the UI
normalises each refit to sum 1), the refit windows and the feature IC table.

AlphaThemeWeights.title: AlphaThemeWeights
AlphaThemeWeights.description: The composite's theme weights by decision date (``theme_weights.parquet``).

avg_daily_cost_bps_of_nav.title: Avg Daily Cost Bps Of Nav

realized_vs_exante_vol_ratio.title: Realized Vs Exante Vol Ratio
realized_vs_exante_vol_ratio.description: realised / ex-ante vol over invested days only; NaN (null) with too few

invested_day_frac.title: Invested Day Frac
invested_day_frac.description: share of decision days with gross exposure > 1e-4 of NAV

effective_n_names.title: Effective N Names
effective_n_names.description: mean over invested days of 1 / sum p_i^2, p_i = |w_i| / gross (null for runs recorded before it)

specific_var_share.title: Specific Var Share
specific_var_share.description: mean specific share of the risk model's ex-ante variance of the book (null when not recorded)

exante_vol_at_gross2.title: Exante Vol At Gross2
exante_vol_at_gross2.description: mean ex-ante annual vol scaled to gross exposure 2: vol x 2 / gross (null when not recorded)

delisting_pnl_ann.title: Delisting Pnl Ann
delisting_pnl_ann.description: annualised sum over delistings of held names of weight x booked delisting return (return on the stock by delisting reason; null for runs recorded before it)

CapacityResult.title: CapacityResult
CapacityResult.description: ``runs/_capacity/<id>.json``.  Not a trial: logged with ``kind: capacity``.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: launchable, but worth a look before spending a trial

config_hash.title: Config Hash
config_hash.description: SystemConfig.hash() of the resulting config; null when invalid

base_config_hash.title: Base Config Hash
base_config_hash.description: hash of the base (the run's config or the defaults)

warmup_days.title: Warmup Days
warmup_days.description: estimated warm-up of the resulting config (trading days)

min_days.title: Min Days
min_days.description: warm-up plus one year: the floor for a synthetic market's days

overrides_applied.title: Overrides Applied
overrides_applied.description: number of override keys applied on the base

ConfigValidation.title: ConfigValidation
ConfigValidation.description:
``POST /api/config/validate``: what a launch with this body would do, without
queueing anything.  ``errors`` are the same issues a launch answers with 422.

CostSeries.title: CostSeries
CostSeries.description: ``ColumnarSeries<CostComponent>``: USD per decision date by component.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: why the family is not known yet; '' when it is

FamilyResolution.title: FamilyResolution
FamilyResolution.description:
The trial family a research command on a store slice logs into, when it can be
known without reading the store (the full-history market hash is cached).

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: composite theme it belongs to, or "ml_only"

feature_set.title: Feature Set
feature_set.description: first feature set that has it (v1 / v2)

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: composite themes and their members in this feature set

store_path.title: Store Path
store_path.description: QTS_STORE_PATH: the ParquetStore store runs read; null when unset

cells.title: Cells
cells.description: one per year of `years`, in order

task.title: Task
task.description: pipeline: a run; otherwise a research or paper-trading task

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: what the task is about: sweep id, book name, signal, ...

result.title: Result
result.description: a finished task's summary (ids, headline numbers)

error_kind.title: Error Kind
error_kind.description: failed jobs: stale_data (exit code 3: the vendor has not published the session yet), book_locked (exit code 4), paper, seal, coverage (the store prefilter misses names the universe picks: use --max-rank), refused (a once-only or seal rule), error

exit_code.title: Exit Code
exit_code.description: failed paper jobs: the `qts paper` exit code

n_overrides.title: N Overrides
n_overrides.description: override keys of the request (0 for an unchanged base)

position.title: Position
position.description: 0-based place in the queue; null unless queued

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: pipeline stage of a running job (short name); '' otherwise

last_log.title: Last Log
last_log.description: last line of the job's log; null before the first line

eta_seconds.title: Eta Seconds
eta_seconds.description: running: estimated seconds left, from finished jobs of similar size; null when there are none

estimated_seconds.title: Estimated Seconds
estimated_seconds.description: estimated total duration from similar finished jobs

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: true when the log has more lines than returned

position.title: Position
position.description: new 0-based place in the queue (clamped to its end)

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: jobs by status (all on disk, not only the listed ones)

JobQueue.title: JobQueue
JobQueue.description:
``GET /api/jobs``: running first, then the queue in order, then the most recent
finished, failed and cancelled jobs.

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: allowed names keyed by the value of the field at choices_key

choices_key.title: Choices Key
choices_key.description: dotted path of the field whose value picks the list in choices (alpha.feature_set)

JsonSchemaArray.title: JsonSchemaArray
JsonSchemaArray.description:
A multi-select field (``alpha.disabled_features``): the allowed names are
``choices[<value of the field at choices_key>]``; as an override it takes a
comma-separated string of names (``--set`` syntax), ``""`` for none.

days.title: Days
days.description: synthetic market length: at least the effective warm-up (GET /api/config/warmup) plus one year; checked against the run's own config at launch

config_overrides.title: Config Overrides
config_overrides.description: dotted-path overrides, e.g. {"portfolio.trade_aversion": 2}; applied on top of the config of `base_run_id` when given, else of the SystemConfig defaults; null only for nullable fields

base_run_id.title: Base Run Id
base_run_id.description: start from this run's config.yaml (run builder: clone and edit); default: SystemConfig()

max_names.title: Max Names
max_names.description: store prefilter: the N ids with the largest peak market cap

min_mcap_ever.title: Min Mcap Ever
min_mcap_ever.description: store prefilter: peak market cap floor in [start, end], USD

max_rank.title: Max Rank
max_rank.description: store prefilter (`qts run --max-rank K`): every id that ranked <= K by market cap among the names passing the universe's price / ADV screens on some date; covers a top-N universe when K >= N / (1 - exclude_bottom_size_quantile). Not with max_names / min_mcap_ever

allow_partial_coverage.title: Allow Partial Coverage
allow_partial_coverage.description: store runs: load although the prefilter misses names the universe picks (look-ahead; flagged on the ledger record; `qts run --allow-partial-coverage`). Default: such a load is refused

cache.title: Cache
cache.description: reuse fitted models from the stage cache (qts --cache)

max_days.title: Max Days
max_days.description: backtest only the last N out-of-sample days (quick runs)

unseal_reason.title: Unseal Reason
unseal_reason.description: store runs: load the sealed holdout (`qts run --unseal REASON`). Once per configuration, logged in the trial ledger before the run starts; cannot be undone

force.title: Force
force.description: with unseal_reason: unseal a configuration whose holdout was already used (flagged)

LaunchRunRequest.title: LaunchRunRequest
LaunchRunRequest.description:
Strict types (pydantic strict mode): ``"stocks": "60"`` or ``"ml": "true"`` are
rejected, not coerced; the label may not contain control characters.

n_not_counted.title: N Not Counted
n_not_counted.description: reference re-runs and records that are not trials

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: record kind: trial (absent = trial), unseal, capacity, calibration, ...

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: a re-run of an already counted configuration

counted.title: Counted
counted.description: enters the family's N and V (an ordinary trial that is not a reference)

note.title: Note
note.description: why the record is not counted, in plain words; null when counted

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: SHA-256 of the text above the '## Result' heading

run.description: the mid-cap run in the registry (null when not on this machine)

sha_matches.title: Sha Matches
sha_matches.description: the result's pre-registration hash equals the note's hash now

previous_runs.title: Previous Runs
previous_runs.description: ledger records of this configuration's check

blocked_reason.title: Blocked Reason
blocked_reason.description: why the launch button is disabled

needs_force.title: Needs Force
needs_force.description: the check already ran: a repeat needs force + the typed phrase

note.title: Note
note.description: why it is safe to continue

last_mode.title: Last Mode
last_mode.description: live or backfill: only live days are paper-trading evidence

paper_root_flag.title: Paper Root Flag
paper_root_flag.description: the --paper-root value the CLI needs for these books; null when it is the default (paper/)

PaperBoundaries.title: PaperBoundaries
PaperBoundaries.description:
The calibrated stop-rule boundaries at each horizon (``boundary_levels`` quantiles
of the reference run's bootstrap): drawdown and Sharpe, WATCH and STOP.

PaperDataSpec.title: PaperDataSpec
PaperDataSpec.description:
How the book loads market data (``qts.paper.book.DataSpec``): ``max_rank`` is the
screened-rank prefilter (default 1,500); a book written before it existed keeps its
peak-cap ``max_names`` / ``min_mcap_ever``, which the load-coverage guard refuses.

stop_rules.title: Stop Rules
stop_rules.description: the pre-registered rules frozen at init

PaperStatus.title: PaperStatus
PaperStatus.description:
``qts.paper.status`` with the series completed (calibrated boundaries per horizon,
the live / backfill mode per day), the book's recent jobs and its last reconciliation.

trading_halted.title: Trading Halted
trading_halted.description: STOP and not acknowledged: no orders until `qts paper ack`

RiskCalibrationResult.title: RiskCalibrationResult
RiskCalibrationResult.description: ``runs/_risk/<id>.json``.  A report: adopting a value is one logged trial.

nav.title: Nav
nav.description: run id -> NAV aligned to `dates` (null where absent)

downsampled.title: Downsampled
downsampled.description: true when the shared axis was thinned to max_points

RunCompare.title: RunCompare
RunCompare.description:
``GET /api/runs/compare?ids=``: NAV series of several runs on one shared date axis
(the union of their realisation dates, thinned to at most ``max_points``), plus the
fold tables, gates and flattened configs the compare view diffs.

n_trials.title: N Trials
n_trials.description: DSR trial count from the ledger family

RunCompareRun.title: RunCompareRun
RunCompareRun.description: One run of a side-by-side comparison.

stocks.title: Stocks
stocks.description: universe size of the input data; null when not recorded

days.title: Days
days.description: days of market data; null when not recorded

RunConfig.title: RunConfig
RunConfig.description: Subset of ``SystemConfig`` the UI reads directly; the full YAML is in ``config_yaml``.

names.title: Names
names.description: constraint names that ever bound, in display order

vol_target_binding.title: Vol Target Binding
vol_target_binding.description: target / caps / bracket / max_solves / no_alpha / solve_failed:* / ''

share_binding.title: Share Binding
share_binding.description: share of rebalances on which each constraint bound

RunConstraints.title: RunConstraints
RunConstraints.description: Per-rebalance constraint log (``constraints.parquet``); empty `dates` for older runs.

execution_venue.title: Execution Venue
execution_venue.description: routing venue of the execution layer, e.g. "closing auction (LOC/MOC)"; null for runs written before it was recorded

latest.description: null when the run has no exposure history

description.title: Description
description.description: what the file holds, for known artifacts; empty otherwise

RunFile.title: RunFile
RunFile.description: One file of the run directory (top level only).

invested_day_frac.title: Invested Day Frac
invested_day_frac.description: share of decision days with gross exposure > 1e-4 of NAV

RunHeadline.title: RunHeadline
RunHeadline.description: Headline numbers shown in the runs list.

method.title: Method
method.description: by construction | measured | no prefilter | skipped

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: false: the load missed names the universe picks (flagged)

RunLoadCoverage.title: RunLoadCoverage
RunLoadCoverage.description:
The store load-coverage guard's verdict for the run's load (``qts.research.coverage``;
the ``load_coverage`` field of its ledger record, or ``launch.json`` for API runs).

ledger_family.title: Ledger Family
ledger_family.description: trial family the run's DSR counted in, as the manifest records it; null for older runs

state.title: State
state.description: sealed: data through sealed_end; unsealed: looked at the holdout; exempt: full history by design (mid-cap check); none: no seal was in force

sealed_end.title: Sealed End
sealed_end.description: last date the run loaded under the seal

holdout_already_used.title: Holdout Already Used
holdout_already_used.description: an earlier unseal of this configuration already looked

record_kind.title: Record Kind
record_kind.description: ledger record kind: trial, capacity, calibration, ...

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: a re-run of an already counted configuration: logged, not counted

load_coverage.description: store runs: the load-coverage guard's verdict (null: not recorded)

RunSeal.title: RunSeal
RunSeal.description: Where a run stands relative to the research holdout seal (``summary.json``).

store_path.title: Store Path
store_path.description: ParquetStore root as recorded (CLI --store or the API's QTS_STORE_PATH)

max_names.title: Max Names
max_names.description: store prefilter: the N ids with the largest peak market cap

min_mcap_ever.title: Min Mcap Ever
min_mcap_ever.description: store prefilter: peak market cap floor, USD

max_rank.title: Max Rank
max_rank.description: store prefilter: every id ranked <= K by screened market cap on some date

max_days.title: Max Days
max_days.description: backtest only the last N out-of-sample days

command.title: Command
command.description: the recorded command line ('' when none)

RunSource.title: RunSource
RunSource.description:
Where a run's market data came from and how the run was invoked: what the run
builder needs to start a new run "from" this one.  Read from ``launch.json`` (runs
launched through the API), else from the CLI command recorded in the manifest
(``qts demo --stocks/--days/--seed``, ``qts run --store/--start/--end/--max-names/
--min-mcap-ever``, ``--ml``, ``--cache``, ``--max-days``); ``recorded`` is false when
neither says (older runs): the fields are then null and the builder asks.

ledger_family.title: Ledger Family
ledger_family.description: trial family the run's DSR counted in (the manifest's); null for older or unfinished runs

headline.description: null while running or after a failure

config_leaves.title: Config Leaves
config_leaves.description: flattened SystemConfig (dotted path -> scalar); empty while running or after a failure

load_end.title: Load End
load_end.description: the last date a sealed load may contain (the day before holdout_start)

n_forced.title: N Forced
n_forced.description: unseals that re-used a holdout already looked at

by_family.title: By Family
by_family.description: family -> {kind: count} of the runs under the seal

inherited_families.title: Inherited Families
inherited_families.description: seal.inherit_family -> its trial count (null: not in this ledger)

SealStatus.title: SealStatus
SealStatus.description: ``qts seal status``: the seal, every unseal, the research runs made under it.

p_holm.title: P Holm
p_holm.description: this test's Holm-adjusted p over the family as it is now

SignalFamilyNow.title: SignalFamilyNow
SignalFamilyNow.description:
The family's multiple-testing state now (later tests raise an earlier test's
Holm-adjusted p): every test logged so far, Holm over all of them.

n_tests.title: N Tests
n_tests.description: tests already logged in the family

adds.title: Adds
adds.description: 1, or 0 with log_trial false (then the test is not counted)

SignalTestPreview.title: SignalTestPreview
SignalTestPreview.description: Before a test: which family it joins and how many tests that family has.

step.title: Step
step.description: sampling step and paper-book holding, days

cache.title: Cache
cache.description: the baseline fit from the stage cache (--no-cache when false)

StoreSlice.title: StoreSlice
StoreSlice.description:
The store slice and prefilter of a research command (``qts ... --store`` flags; the
store itself is the API server's ``QTS_STORE_PATH``).

expected_id.title: Expected Id
expected_id.description: the id of the confirmed preview: refused if the plan changed

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: this sweep's member and finalize jobs, newest first

active.title: Active
active.description: queued or running jobs of this sweep

resumable.title: Resumable
resumable.description: members not done and not queued or running

exists.title: Exists
exists.description: a manifest with this id exists: launching resumes it

SweepPlanView.title: SweepPlanView
SweepPlanView.description: ``plan_sweep``: the members, the family and the DSR haircut; nothing written.

command.title: Command
command.description: the equivalent `qts` command line (recorded on the job)

TrialImpact.title: TrialImpact
TrialImpact.description: ``qts.research.sweep.trial_impact``: the effect of new trials on a family's DSR.

requires_force.title: Requires Force
requires_force.description: true: this configuration's holdout is already used

UnsealCheck.title: UnsealCheck
UnsealCheck.description: Earlier unseals of one configuration (same normalised config hash and phase).

min_days.title: Min Days
min_days.description: warmup_days + one year (trading_days_per_year): the launch floor

risk_days.title: Risk Days
risk_days.description: risk exposures warm-up + min_history_days of factor returns

ml_days.title: Ml Days
ml_days.description: universe lead + alpha.train_min_days + embargo (upper bound); null without ML

exact.title: Exact
exact.description: true when the (exact) risk term binds

Warmup.title: Warmup
Warmup.description:
Effective warm-up of a run (``qts.pipeline.estimate_warmup_days``): trading
days of the market panel used before the first out-of-sample backtest date.

ApiErrorBody.description: RFC 7807 problem details (``application/problem+json``); ``detail`` is always a string.
ApiErrorBody.title: ApiErrorBody
